T1.answer: SV1 (Heritage Savings, all opened before 2009) accrues on 30/360: the 31st accrues 0 days and the last day of February accrues up to day 30 (3 days in a 28-day Feb). SV2 and MMA accrue actual/365 (365 even in leap years). CHK earns no interest. SV1 must stay a separate product and never be converted to SV2 (2016 regulatory complaint). The planned SV3 Heritage Plus keeps the Heritage 30/360 terms.
T1.source: Helen Brandt (team_chat) after a Slack nudge to po in s1d1; INTCALC product table and 2200-GET-DAYS

T2.answer: Daily accrual is truncated (not rounded) to 6 decimals; month-end posting rounds to cents with banker's rounding (half-even, ROUNDED MODE NEAREST-EVEN).

T3.answer: Dates are Julian YYDDD PIC 9(5) with a century window in DATEUTIL 9000-CONVERT-JULIAN: YY < 70 means 20YY, otherwise 19YY. So a 1968/1969 opening date reads as 2068/2069 in legacy; the business chose to leave those, and the new system must reproduce legacy.

T4.answer: Full account numbers must never appear in application logs, batch reports or audit records, and that includes exports and partner files: mask to the last 4 digits (******1234) under RF-2025-07. Customer statements are exempt. Every balance change needs an audit record with before, after and the masked account.
T4.source: Slack to sec s1d1; Mei Lin

D1.answer: BigDecimal with scale 4 (directive CFO-2025-03, sprint 3, for phase-2 FX), replacing the sprint-1 PMO guidance of long minor units (cents); rounding to cents only at posting and fees.
D1.source: Slack to arch s1d1 (long cents), reversed by Slack to arch s3d1; Daniel Okoro

D2.answer: $25.00 per overdraft event (PC-2025-14), capped at 3 overdraft fees per statement month (PC-2025-21, sprint 4), so at most $75.00 a month. Both are approved deviations from legacy, which charged $35.00 per event with no cap.
D2.stale_answer: $35.00 per event, or $25.00 with no cap
D2.source: Slack to po s2d1 and s4d1; Owen Achterberg

I1.answer: INC-0042: a mobile retry with the same TXN-REF and a new TXN-ID was posted twice by the new system. Legacy XFERPROC rejects a non-blank TXN-REF already posted earlier the same business day with reason DUP (the 'CHANNEL RETRY GUARD'); rejected transactions do not count and next-day repeats post. Fix: a per-business-day duplicate check on TXN-REF.
I1.source: Slack to dev-pay and ops s4d1; XFERPROC 2010-DUP-CHECK; Carla Mendes; Pat Quinn

O1.answer: At month end, CHK accounts (active or frozen) with a balance below $500.00 before fees pay a $5.00 maintenance fee (MF), written before the overdraft fee. Unchanged from legacy.

O2.answer: Only CHK may go negative; the overdraft count goes up by one each time a debit takes the balance from >= 0 to < 0. Savings products reject with NSF instead. Fee = count x fee at month end (now capped at 3), then the count resets.

P1.answer: Sprint 4 of 4: the parallel-run dress rehearsal and go-live readiness. Go-live requires golden-master parity for 2025-02-01..2025-03-31 (daily POSTED, REJECTS and ACCTMAST, plus month-end statements) except deviations the business approved in writing.

P3.answer: Two, both on the overdraft fee: $25.00 per event instead of $35.00 (PC-2025-14) and a cap of 3 overdraft fees per statement month (PC-2025-21). Everything else must match legacy.

E1.answer: Policy ENG-7: the first line of every commit message must start with a tracker key, e.g. 'LH-123: Add accrual job'; a workstation git hook rejects anything else (merges and reverts excepted).
E1.source: wiki Engineering conventions; the hook's rejection message

E2.answer: CI runs ci-lint after the build: L1 no System.out/System.err printing in production code (use the logger); L2 every TODO/FIXME names its ticket, TODO(LH-123). Local verify does not run it; py bin/lint.py does.
E2.source: wiki Engineering conventions; red CI messages
